claims.statement: 指定右框的希望答案是出口；選區與辨字是可分別失敗的任務，固定框成功不等於自動尋找文字。入口、出口、開關都在主線已指定的有限字表內。
claims.scope: Author-defined target semantics and proposed finite alphabet; no observed model answer or automatic detection capability is claimed.

evidence.supports: Text detection localizes text; recognition transcribes chosen image content. Recognition using ground-truth crops does not evaluate localization.
The 12-character prospective alphabet contains 入/出/口/開/關; fixed-frame success explicitly excludes unrestricted detection.

evidence.locator: two glyph text nodes and green right-region rectangle
evidence.supports: The visible right selected region contains 出口, left contains 入口.
Independently checks exact authored target mapping and alphabet membership, without OCR inference.

claims.statement: 按座標裁切僅取出一塊像素，不會認字；先裁切再辨字移除框外像素。保留整圖與框位置是另一種需訓練模型使用指定區域的安排。
claims.scope: Geometry and design alternatives. No claim that the repository has implemented/accepted the optional whole-image region-conditioned route.

evidence.supports: The four coordinates select a rectangular image region; the operation performs no text recognition.
Ground-truth-box cropping supplies textline pixels; a separate learned feature/decoder path transcribes text.

evidence.locator: §3 p.4; Appendix A Table 13 p.20, Region to text
evidence.supports: An original architecture consumes image/text/region and predicts text using region tokens; this supports the alternative conditioning contract only.
4×2 unique-pixel input cropped to left/right 2×2 has exact disjoint expected pixels.

claims.statement: 讀字入口從像素取得特徵並由文字核心生成字串；示範應把材料、指定框和範圍一致的有序答案配對。總把整張抄寫作答案會教整張抄寫這個目標。
claims.scope: Supervised target contract, not a guarantee of convergence. Full material/box may be retained in the data record while preprocessing gives the recognizer only the selected crop.

evidence.supports: Image features feed a token decoder; original ordered ground-truth sequences supervise predictions with cross-entropy.
Image plus task/region instructions and target sequence define the supervised conditional generation objective.
The course proposes self-trained input/projection/core and separate reading scope; mature source models' pretrained success is not adopted as course evidence.

claims.statement: 同圖換指定左框應讀入口；保持右框並互換兩區內容應改讀入口；右框內容改開關應讀開關。固定右側總是出口可能容許位置猜詞，不能直接證明用了字形。
claims.scope: Counterfactual intended-answer table and a possible shortcut. No actual model was evaluated or diagnosed.

evidence.supports: Correlated cues can solve benchmark examples without intended ability; tests with well-defined changed solutions distinguish shortcut-compatible behavior.
Four exact target cases verify that output follows selected region content and changes under the stated interventions.

claims.statement: 入口出口包含目標字但抄了框外內容；口出字種相同卻字序錯，出口才符合本題完整答案。需另用字體/版面變體和已知字元新短串檢查泛化；清晰有限字卡不足以推出模糊、傾斜、未見字的真實招牌能力。
claims.scope: Ordered content/range evaluation and justified limitations. The auxiliary CPU edit counts are checks of the existing Unicode helper, not a new OCR score reported by this section.

evidence.locator: §3.3 p.5: CER formula and reference text denominator
evidence.supports: Ordered character insertion/deletion/substitution comparison differs from merely counting appearing characters.
Existing helper checks whole string exact equality and ordered Unicode edit distance with reference length.
出口 exact; 入口出口 and 口出 both non-exact; additional 出入/入口 substitutions distinguish order/content/range examples.
Unseen-data and independent-group tests distinguish memorization from generalization.
Success on a narrow dataset does not establish intended broad ability or transfer to different conditions.
